answer_2.quote: We evaluate UI Agent (represented by UFO) and AXIS on 50 Word-related tasks using explored skills. Table 1 presents comparative results, including completion time, success rates, step counts, and LLM backend costs ...

answer_4.quote: We conduct an extensive user experiment to evaluate the performance of AXIS. The experiment and evaluation metrics are designed to explore the following research questions... Participants are asked to complete specified tasks... NASA-TLX metrics: Mental, Physical, and Temporal Demand; Performance; Frustration; and Effort... For Agent-assisted tasks, additional metrics include Agent fluency/reliability, UI dependency, decision consistency, and perceived completion speed.
answer_4.guideline: Post‑task questionnaires (NASA‑TLX) and additional surveys assessing fluency, reliability, UI dependency, decision consistency, and perceived speed.
